Shanghai Municipal Council.

May 10th 1916

POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH)

Sir,
Chiangchun Feng has given instructions to General Yang that Chu Tsung Eu, a Cantonese whose arrest in the vicinity of the Arsenal on suspicion of being a rebel spy was referred to in the reports on the 3rd and 4th instants, be sent to Nanking. It is said that Chu will be released in Nanking, some influential friends having interceded with Chiangchun Feng on his behalf.
A report to the effect that the soldiers in Kiangyin receive a bonus in debentures equal to half their wages each month has been in circulation in military circles for the past few days. It is said that the soldiers at the Arsenal and Woosung intend to apply for a similar bonus.
It is reported that Sun Yat Sen 孫逸仙 is trying to convene a large public meeting in connection with the rebel movement.
It is reported that Li Ping Su 李平書 formerly Chairman of the Chinese Municipal Council and that he will be one of the rebel representatives in a peace conference here.
It is reported that the Central Government intends to send eight more regiments to Shanghai as the loyalty of some of the soldiers is doubted.
Some twenty members of the Chapel Police have applied for permission to resign during the past few days. Their resignations were not accepted.

Your Obedient Servant,

for Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

上海工部局。

1916年5月10日

警务处，
（侦探股）

先生：

冯国璋已向杨将军下达指令，将朱宗欧（Chu Tsung Eu，音译）送往南京。此人为广东籍，此前因涉嫌为反叛分子充当间谍而在兵工厂附近被捕，此事已见于本月3日及4日的报告中。据悉，朱宗欧将在南京获释，因其有几位颇具影响力的朋友已向冯国璋为其说情。

近日，军界流传着一份报告，称江阴的士兵每月可获得相当于其工资一半的债券作为奖金。据说，兵工厂和吴淞的士兵也打算申请类似的奖金。

据报道，孙逸仙正试图召开一次大型公众集会，以推动反叛运动。

据报道，李平书曾任上海城厢内外总工程局（Chinese Municipal Council）董事，他将作为反叛分子的代表之一参加在此举行的和平会议。

据报道，中央政府打算再向上海派遣八个团，因为部分士兵的忠诚度受到怀疑。

在过去几天里，约有二十名教堂巡捕（Chapel Police，音译）申请辞职，但未获批准。

您顺从的仆人，

代首席侦探督察长。

警务处总监
